title: Flue Agent — Incident Command Board
description: Command board for the Cloud Clanker incidents: severity counts, root-vs-cascade matrix, evidence table, required invariants, and immediate priority sequence. Uses direct transcript and code evidence.

rootCascadeMatrix.primary_cascade: Missing deliverable → unrecoverable; user sees 'completed' without content
Completed before provider acceptance → silent loss / no redelivery
Workspace destroyed → files lost; later recovery impossible

rootCascadeMatrix.root_cause: Coarse setup retry scope (no stage checkpoints)
rootCascadeMatrix.primary_cascade: Repeated setup work and terminal failures; lost resume points
Progress lost or misleading status → agent improvises around missing control tooling
Repair prompts spawn new tasks instead of resending previous results

rootCascadeMatrix.root_cause: Completion schema accepts any non-empty summary
rootCascadeMatrix.primary_cascade: Freeform prose satisfies completion without expected result kind

evidenceTable.evidence: Agent claims transcript prepared but no message delivered
evidenceTable.proves: Agent finished model work; claims prepared output
evidenceTable.does_not_prove: That Telegram delivery succeeded or that a durable result exists

evidenceTable.proves: Task state advanced to completed in ledger
evidenceTable.does_not_prove: Provider acceptance or durable result persisted

evidenceTable.proves: Agent attempted a repo/tool operation in a general task's scratch workspace
evidenceTable.does_not_prove: That repo read caused missing final deliverable

evidenceTable.evidence: Task setup failed after retries message
evidenceTable.proves: Setup stage reached a terminal error after retries
evidenceTable.does_not_prove: Which specific infra or auth sub-step failed (protected logs hidden)

props.caption: Evidence table: transcript and code citations, and what each proves / cannot prove

rows.title: No completion without a result
rows.body: Terminal success requires a non-empty, schema-valid deliverable or durable artifact reference (from incident report invariants).

rows.title: No completion before delivery
rows.body: Telegram acknowledgement must be persisted; failures enter a retryable delivery state.

rows.title: Results outlive sandboxes
rows.body: Bounded result text/artifacts are written durably before sandbox teardown.

rows.title: Redelivery never reruns work
rows.body: Resend reads ledger/artifact store and uses idempotency keys.

rows.title: Retries resume stages
rows.body: Setup and execution have separate durable attempt/checkpoint records.

props.code:
flowchart LR
  U[User Telegram] -->|Task request| Ingress[Ingress + TaskLedger]
  Ingress --> Queue[TASK_QUEUE]
  Queue --> Setup[Setup stages: auth, network, workspace]
  Setup -->|dispatch| Exec[Flue dispatch / execution]
  Exec --> Validate[Structured result validator]
  Validate --> Persist[task_results + R2 artifact manifest]
  Persist --> Outbox[durable outbox entry]
  Outbox --> Delivery[Queue consumer -> Telegram]
  Delivery -->|provider accepted| Ledger[task_delivery accepted]
  Delivery -->|failure| Ledger[task_delivery retry_wait/unknown_after_send]
props.caption: Minimal flow showing the critical persist-before-deliver invariant

props.content:
### Immediate priorities (short sequence)

1) Block empty completions; 2) Persist canonical result; 3) Persist outbound intent before Sandbox teardown; 4) Add delivery outbox and resend; 5) Split setup/execution/delivery states.
